主要内容: DISH Network Corporation, through its subsidiary L-Band Acquisition, LLC (LBAC), terminated a Plan Support Agreement (PSA) with LightSquared LP Lenders on January 7, 2014. The PSA, which was previously disclosed, allowed LBAC to terminate the agreement if certain milestones were not met. The termination became effective at 11:59 P.M. Eastern time on January 10, 2014. The termination was based on the failure to meet the agreed-upon milestones. The PSA was filed as an exhibit to DISH's Form 8-K on July 23, 2013. The termination of the PSA marks a significant development in DISH's strategic initiatives involving LightSquared LP.
